name: titlemap-scroll
description: Reads the TITLEMAP's sidedef texture offsets tic by tic. A Boom wall scroller (specials 100-103) shows up here as an offset that advances exactly 0.5 texels per tic on all three slots of the front sidedef: 78 linedefs of Lullaby's title map do it, and that is how fast its mountains slide.
